Man Arrested in Gujarat for Alleged Lion Cub Killing

A man has been arrested in Junagadh, Gujarat, in connection with the killing of a lion cub. The forest department stated that the accused has a history of killing several dogs and snakes. This incident highlights ongoing concerns regarding wildlife protection in the region.
